markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 连接词像**句子之间的路标**，告诉听的人下一句往哪走：**再加一点**（also）、**拐个弯**（but、however）、**说结果**（so、therefore）。

uses.en: We fixed the crash. We [[also]] made the login faster.
uses.en_zh: 我们修好了崩溃，还让登录变快了。

uses.en: The design looks great. [[However]], it's hard to build.
uses.en_zh: 设计看着很棒，不过很难做出来。

uses.en: The server was down, [[so]] we couldn't test.
uses.en_zh: 服务器挂了，所以我们没法测试。

add.title: 再加一点
add.rule: also 放在**动词前面**（be 动词后面）；too 和 as well 放在**句子最后**。in addition 更正式，放句子开头。

examples.en: Can you check the iPad layout [[as well]]?
examples.zh: 你能把 iPad 的布局也看一下吗？

examples.en: [[In addition]], we need a new privacy policy.
examples.zh: 另外，我们还需要一份新的隐私政策。

but.title: 拐个弯
but.rule: but 连在一句话**中间**；**however 一般放新句子开头，后面加逗号**，比 but 正式。although 带着半句话，不能单独站着。

examples.en: It's a small change, [[but]] it took all day.
examples.zh: 这个改动很小，但花了一整天。

examples.en: The tests passed. [[However]], the app still crashes on old iPhones.
examples.zh: 测试都过了。不过 App 在旧 iPhone 上还是会崩。

examples.en: [[Although]] it was raining, we went for a walk.
examples.zh: 虽然在下雨，我们还是去散步了。

wrong.bad: The tests passed~~, however~~ the app still crashes.
wrong.good: The tests passed. [[However]], the app still crashes.

compare.title: 两边对比
compare.rule: whereas 和 while 把**两样东西摆在一起**，说它们不一样。没有「没想到」的感觉，只是左边这样、右边那样。

examples.en: Android uses Kotlin, [[whereas]] iOS uses Swift.
examples.zh: 安卓用 Kotlin，而 iOS 用 Swift。

examples.en: I like working early, [[while]] Tom prefers late nights.
examples.zh: 我喜欢早点干活，而汤姆喜欢熬夜。

notes: whereas 连的是一句话里的两半；However 后面是新的一句，两个不能随便换。

result.title: 说结果
result.rule: so 最口语，放在两句中间。**therefore 和 as a result 更正式**，常放在新句子开头，后面加逗号。

examples.en: The API changed, [[so]] we had to update the app.
examples.zh: 接口改了，所以我们得更新 App。

examples.en: The build failed. [[As a result]], the release was delayed.
examples.zh: 构建失败了，结果发布推迟了。

examples.en: Very few people use iOS 15. [[Therefore]], we'll drop it.
examples.zh: 用 iOS 15 的人很少，所以我们不再支持它。

reason.title: 说原因
reason.rule: because 后面跟**一整句话**（有人、有动作）；because of 和 due to 后面只跟**一个名词**。since 放句首是「既然」，后面也跟一整句话。

examples.en: We stayed in [[because]] it was raining.
examples.zh: 因为下雨，我们待在家里。

examples.en: The flight was cancelled [[because of]] the fog.
[[Since]] you're here, can you review my PR?
examples.zh: 既然你在，能帮我看下 PR 吗？

this.en: I left early [[because]] I was tired.

that.en: I was tired, [[so]] I left early.

commonMistakes.bad: Although it was late, ~~but~~ we kept working.
commonMistakes.good: [[Although]] it was late, we kept working.
commonMistakes.why: 中文能说「虽然……但是」，英文 although 和 but 只能用一个。

commonMistakes.bad: Because it was raining, ~~so~~ we stayed in.
commonMistakes.good: [[Because]] it was raining, we stayed in.
commonMistakes.why: 中文能说「因为……所以」，英文 because 和 so 只能用一个。

commonMistakes.good: [[Because of]] the traffic, I was late.
commonMistakes.why: the traffic 只是名词，用 because of。

commonMistakes.good: I [[also]] like it. / I like it [[too]].
commonMistakes.why: too 放句尾；放动词前用 also。

quiz.prompt: The server was down, ___ we couldn't test the app.
I fixed the crash. I ___ updated the docs.
quiz.explain: 放在动词前面的是 [[also]]；too 和 as well 放句尾。

quiz.prompt: Can you check the iPad layout as ___?
I like it, and my wife likes it ___.
改错：Although it was late, but we kept working.
quiz.answer: Although it was late, we kept working.
accept: It was late, but we kept working.
Although it was late we kept working.

quiz.prompt: The tests passed. ___, the app still crashes on older iPhones.
quiz.explain: 新句子开头，后面有逗号：[[However]]。

quiz.prompt: 用 although 改写：It was raining, but we went for a walk.
quiz.answer: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.
accept: We went for a walk although it was raining.
Although it was raining we went for a walk.

quiz.prompt: Android apps are often written in Kotlin, ___ iOS apps use Swift.
I like working early in the morning, ___ my brother prefers late nights.
The build failed. As a ___, the release was delayed.
quiz.explain: 正式地说结果：[[As a result]]。

quiz.prompt: Very few people use iOS 15. ___, we'll stop supporting it.
The flight was cancelled ___ the fog.
改错：Because it was raining, so we stayed in.
quiz.answer: Because it was raining, we stayed in.
accept: It was raining, so we stayed in.
We stayed in because it was raining.

quiz.prompt: 用 so 改写：I left early because I was tired.
quiz.answer: I was tired, so I left early.
accept: I was tired so I left early.
quiz.explain: 原因在前，[[so]] 后面说结果。

options: The design is great, however it's hard to build.
The design is great. However, it's hard to build.
The design is great however, it's hard to build.
quiz.answer: The design is great. However, it's hard to build.
quiz.explain: [[However]] 开一个新句子，后面加逗号；也可以直接换成 but。

quiz.prompt: 翻译：这个改动很小，但是花了一整天。
quiz.answer: It's a small change, but it took all day.
accept: It was a small change, but it took all day.
It's a small change, but it took the whole day.
It was a small change, but it took the whole day.
The change is small, but it took all day.
The change was small, but it took all day.
The change was small, but it took the whole day.

openTask.prompt: 用 3 到 4 句话讲一次项目出问题的经过：发生了什么、为什么、结果怎样。至少用到 however、so / therefore、because / because of 中的三个。
rules: although 不和 but 一起用，because 不和 so 一起用
because 后面接句子，because of 后面接名词
however 开头的句子后面加逗号
openTask.note: 规则判连接词的搭配（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
